title: Sensibo AC Runtime Runtime Leaderboard
dataSources: Zigbee2MQTT device reports (`zigbee2mqtt:device`), Shelly/Tasmota telemetry (`shelly:status`, `tasmota:sensor`), Hue bridge events (`hue:event`), Nest/Ecobee thermostat (`ecobee:thermostat`), door/leak/motion sensors.
app: Philips Hue, smart plugs (Tasmota/Shelly/TP-Link Kasa), thermostats (Nest/Ecobee), locks, and Zigbee/Z-Wave sensors via MQTT / Zigbee2MQTT and HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=sensibo:climate runtime_min=*
| stats sum(runtime_min) as total_value, avg(runtime_min) as avg_value by room
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks room values by total and average runtime across Sensibo AC runtime events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `runtime_min` values for each Sensibo AC runtime event and review total and average runtime by room.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total runtime.
grandmaExplanation: It regularly which room shows the biggest runtime numbers in your Sensibo AC runtime data.
